integrity: Exact symbolic and path enumeration checks supplement a self-contained all-parameter analytic proof; verification is not independent. Literature coverage cannot rule out uncatalogued equivalent identities.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the three-unit-vector equiangular planar tight frame, constant 0<eta<2, fixed inconsistent right-hand sides, fresh independently drawn reshuffle permutations and independent-with-replacement row draws; expected squared solution error at complete-epoch endpoints. The comparison is not asserted for other geometries, shuffled-once, individual-iterate almost-sure rates, or per-visit resampled noise.
title: Two sharp sampling thresholds for inconsistent equiangular Kaczmarz
